_comment: Retirements of GENERATED per-project artifacts - the cleanup the upstream file compare can never name, because generated output was never a stack-shipped file. The update command applies these (with the same one-gate consent as its prune list) and validate flags them; detection is existence-based, never version math, so a leftover is caught no matter how old the install. Paths resolve against the install root (the project's .claude/ parent, or the account dir in global mode); a path that does not exist simply does not detect. Every entry names why the artifact is redundant and what regenerates its replacement.

migrations.why: style delivery moved to the generated path-scoped project-code-style rule - the hook's injected context never reached subagent tool calls
migrations.then: re-run /project-code-style-analyzer so the replacement rule gets generated
